provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: scaleT=10/scaleS=100 imply 0.1-s time units and cm elevations in the spherical run's station files (matching ../input/blowup_depth.f's *100 depth scaling).
audit_member_text: The meanings and source units behind scaleT=10.0 and scaleS=100. are not stated, so the resulting time and eta units cannot be independently validated from this file.

base_member_text: The lag variable is still named time_lag_case_A (L8) with value 23.34 -- the same value as the Cartesian case B script; whether it is correct for the spherical case B run is not determinable here.
xlabel 'x (m)' (L47) on a time axis -- same label error as the sibling scripts.

audit_member_text: Definite label/data mismatch across lines 12, 18-27, and 47: every horizontal series is a time column, and model coordinates are explicitly divided by scaleT and shifted by a time lag, yet the bottom subplot labels that axis 'x (m)' rather than time.

Copy/paste naming inconsistency: this Case B script loads B.txt on line 2 but defines and uses the lag as time_lag_case_A on lines 8, 18, 21, 24, and 27; the value is applied consistently, but the identifier falsely attributes the Case B setting to Case A and risks wrong-variable reuse during maintenance.

The code assumes B.txt has at least five columns (lines 12-16), each station file has at least two columns (lines 18-28), and the paired columns used in each plot have compatible row counts (lines 39 and 41); no shape validation or load-error handling precedes indexing.
